title: How to count the total words in a range
task: Word-count across many cells at once — content sheets, survey answers, translations.

excel.note: Assumes no fully blank cells in the range — each blank inflates the count by 1 (see below).

explanation: Per cell, words = spaces + 1: LEN minus LEN-without-spaces counts the spaces, TRIM guards against padding, and SUMPRODUCT totals it across the range — 2 + 1 + 3 = 6 here. The known flaw: an empty cell still contributes +1. The blank-safe version subtracts them: add -SUMPRODUCT(--(TRIM(A2:A4)="")) or filter blanks out first with the FILTER-based patterns. For one cell only, the simpler count-words-in-a-cell recipe covers it.
